find_caltab — CALIB target op

• Data kinds: image2d → keypoints

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.find_caltab(image, thresh=0.5) (to call the implementation directly, import caltab; caltab.find_caltab(image, thresh=0.5); from the registry, opscalib.get("find_caltab"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Detects the centres of the circular marks of a calibration plate in an image (centroids of connected components) (find_caltab).
